name: fantasy-movie-poster
title_zh: 把一句话故事梗概变成 9:16 中文电影海报
tagline_zh: 给一句梗概、类型词或参考图，它产出分层海报：背景图与字体排版分离，可单独微调。覆盖爱情、体育、律政、公路、犯罪。
tagline_en: Feed it a logline, genre tag, or reference image—get a layered poster with separate background and typography.
desc_en: Design original 9:16 Chinese-language cinematic movie posters from story briefs, genre keywords, or visual references, including layered cover workflows with separate image-designed background and typography layers. Use for romance, sports, historical/legal drama, road films, crime thrillers, war, Eastern ink, sci-fi isolation, ensemble casts, and playful concept films. Do not use to copy an exist
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是按片种自动匹配视觉语法：水墨留白、犯罪低饱和、科幻冷调。排版层独立于画面层。
why_en: Not a template mill—it maps genre to visual grammar: ink-wash negative space, crime desaturation, sci-fi cool tones. Typography.
limit_zh: 只做原创合成，不复制任何现存海报或剧照；输入需为中文梗概或明确类型词，纯英文或抽象意象会降低匹配度。输出为设计稿。
limit_en: Original compositions only—no copying existing posters or stills. Needs Chinese brief or clear genre tags; pure English or abstract mood words.
title_en: Turn a story brief into a 9:16 Chinese movie poster
